Select: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary JOIN compound_records ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno. compound_records JOIN docs ON compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id. molecule_dictionary JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123890'. compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort: chembl_id ASC, compound_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC. Deduplication: Return distinct rows.
